scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@couplerh/payroll-core run typecheck && npm --workspace=@couplerh/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@couplerh/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@couplerh/payroll-core run test && npm --workspace=@couplerh/api run test && npm --workspace=@couplerh/web run test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=@couplerh/payroll-core run lint && npm --workspace=@couplerh/api run lint && npm --workspace=@couplerh/web run lint
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
